abilities.name: Universal Diagnosis
abilities.caveat: The Gossamer Sprite heals all nearby party members once, when it returns after finishing its attacks (or right away if no opponents are nearby).
_curatorNotes: Skill heal authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10 as a single onCast (skill) team heal. gcsim skill.go skillHealing(): Player.Heal with Target -1 (all party members) → target 'team' (kit: 'healing all nearby party members'). Fires once after the Gossamer Sprite's attack chain completes and it returns (skillReturnTravel=51 frames after the last chain hit, or immediately via chain() when no enemy is found); represented as onCast since the schema has no delayed-single-heal trigger, so the return-travel delay is a timing simplification. TL10: skillHealPP[9]=0.144 (14.4% Max HP) + skillHealFlat[9]=1694.9546 (sidecar 'Healing' 10th column '14.40% Max HP+1695'). gcsim indexes the skill-heal arrays with TalentLvlBurst() — a gcsim quirk; at TL10 both talent indexers resolve to index 9, and in-game the heal scales with the Universal Diagnosis (Skill) talent.
abilities.description:
Controls a Gossamer Sprite that cruises and attacks nearby opponents, dealing Dendro DMG.
After it performs 3 attacks or if there are no opponents nearby, the Sprite will return, healing all nearby party members based on Baizhu's Max HP.

abilities.name: Holistic Revivification
_curatorNotes: Generator had behavior: 'stance' — changed to 'instant'. The burst does not replace normals/charge. It creates a 14s Pulsing Clarity state that generates periodic Seamless Shields: first at frame 81 (burstFirstShield=81), then 5 more at burstFirstRefresh=142 + burstRefreshRate=146 intervals. Each shield has burstShieldExpiry=152 frame lifespan (~2.5s). Spiritvein DMG fires when a new shield is generated on top of an existing one, or when a shield expires/shatters. Duration 14s taken from genshin-db (gcsim has no explicit duration constant). Seamless Shield (shield window) and Seamless Shield Healing are now authored (see below); Spiritvein DMG remains unauthored (separate finding — it would be a `damage` effect fired on shield-refresh-over-existing and on shield expiry/shatter; C6 adds +8% Max HP FlatDmg, already stubbed on the C6 node).

Seamless Shield authored 2026-07-12 as a single onCast (burst) shield window covering the 14s Pulsing Clarity state (canonical shield-window shape per the onShieldEnd derivation: Effect.type 'shield' + onCast + explicit duration). gcsim shield.go newShield(): Target -1 (party-wide, protects the on-field character) → target 'active'; Element Dendro. TL10 per-shield absorption: burstShieldPP[9]=0.0144 (1.44% Max HP) + burstShieldFlat[9]=169.4954 (sidecar 'Seamless Shield DMG Absorption' 10th column '1.44% Max HP+169'). duration 14 represents the continuous-coverage window (first shield at frame 81≈1.35s, regenerated every burstRefreshRate=146f≈2.43s, each lasting burstShieldExpiry=152f≈2.53s); the onCast window starts at cast rather than frame 81 (a ~1.35s timing simplification) and the per-shield amount refreshes rather than stacks (durationType 'fixed'). 250% Dendro DMG absorption effectiveness not modelled — no per-element shield-efficiency primitive (same gap class as Diona/Thoma/Kaeya).

Seamless Shield Healing authored 2026-07-12 as a summonTick heal on the Pulsing Clarity summon. gcsim burst.go summonSeamlessShieldHealing(): Player.Heal Target c.Core.Player.Active() → target 'active' (heals only the on-field character; kit: 'heal your own active character'). Heals fire on the 5 shield refreshes (NOT the first shield — gcsim comment 'no heal on first shield') at frames 223/369/515/661/807 (burstFirstShield 81 + burstFirstRefresh 142 + burstRefreshRate 146×i, i=0..4): interval 146f≈2.43s, first heal 223f≈3.72s from cast (Pulsing Clarity spawnsAt=0). With duration 14 this yields 5 ticks (3.72/6.15/8.58/11.02/13.45s), matching gcsim's 5 refresh heals; a 6th expiry heal (removeShield on the final shield's expiry ~16s) falls outside the summon window and is not rendered. Kit rounds the regen cadence to 'every 2.5s'. TL10: burstHealPP[9]=0.0936 (9.36% Max HP) + burstHealFlat[9]=1101.7205 (sidecar 'Seamless Shield Healing' 10th column '9.36% Max HP+1102').
abilities.caveat: The Seamless Shield regenerates about every 2.4s across the 14s Pulsing Clarity window and heals the active character each time it refreshes. The absorption shown is for one shield and refreshes rather than stacking, so total protection over the window is higher. The shield absorbs Dendro damage much more effectively, which isn't reflected here.
abilities.description:
Enters the Pulsing Clarity state, creating a Seamless Shield that absorbs Dendro DMG with 250% effectiveness.
While in this state, Baizhu will generate a new Seamless Shield every 2.5s.

The Seamless Shield will heal your own active character based on Baizhu's Max HP and attack opponents by unleashing Spiritveins, dealing Dendro DMG under the following circumstances:
·When a character is under the protection of a Seamless Shield and a new Seamless Shield is generated.
·When the Seamless Shield's effects expire, or when it is shattered.

passives.name: Five Fortunes Forever
_curatorNotes: Migrated to passive trigger 2026-05-09 (F1). gcsim registers permanent stat mods that evaluate active character HP ratio at runtime; the planner doesn't track per-segment HP, so the HP-conditional gating isn't enforced — the +25% dendroDmgBonus branch always renders. Healing Bonus branch (HP < 50%) intentionally not authored as a second effect to avoid double-rendering.
passives.description:
Baizhu gains different effects according to the current HP of your current active character:
·When their HP is less than 50%, Baizhu gains 20% Healing Bonus.
·When their HP is equal to or more than 50%, Baizhu gains 25% Dendro DMG Bonus.

passives.name: All Things Are of the Earth
_curatorNotes: Scaling buff — value field deleted. Effect scales with Baizhu's Max HP (cap 50,000 HP): per 1,000 HP, grants Aggravate/Spread DMG Bonus +0.8%, Burning/Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon +2%, Lunar-Bloom +0.7%. Reaction list needs KQM verification. Effect lasts 6s (gcsim: 6*60=360 frames). Trigger appears incorrect: generator set onReaction:burning, but gcsim fires a4() inside summonSeamlessShieldHealing() — the real trigger is 'healed by Seamless Shield'. Target in gcsim is active character, not team/self. Reviewer to author: correct trigger, HP-scaling value formula, duration field (6s), and full reaction-type list.
passives.description: Characters who are healed by Seamless Shields will gain the Year of Verdant Favor effect: Each 1,000 Max HP that Baizhu possesses that does not exceed 50,000 will increase the Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon reaction DMG dealt by these characters by 2%, their Lunar-Bloom DMG by 0.7%, and the DMG Bonus provided by Aggravate and Spread by 0.8%. This effect lasts 6s.

constellations.name: Incisive Discernment
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger. Likely onHit (OnEnemyDamage) filtered to active character; 5s ICD (gcsim: c2ICDKey 60*5=300 frames). Gossamer Sprite: Splice is ElementalSkill DMG, 250% ATK, Dendro. Also includes C2 healing (20% of Universal Diagnosis heal amount, not authored as effect).
constellations.description:
When your own active character hits a nearby opponent with their attacks, Baizhu will unleash a Gossamer Sprite: Splice.
Gossamer Sprite: Splice will initiate 1 attack before returning, dealing 250% of Baizhu's ATK as Dendro DMG and healing for 20% of Universal Diagnosis's Gossamer Sprite's normal healing.
DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
